title: Ulyana and the Salt
premise: Coral Brightwater, a runaway hedge-witch's apprentice, is guiding a smuggler's caravan through the Thornfell mountains when she discovers tonight's date inscribed in a century-old book of prophecies — and her own name beside it. The prophecy names her the 'Salt-Bearer' who must descend into the court beneath the mountain to reclaim a soul sold there by her own grandmother: the soul of Ulyana, a salt-witch bound in service to the Undercourt. Accompanied by Wren, a disgraced court scribe who knows the prophecies too well, Coral must steal Ulyana's soul back before the moon completes its thirteenth turn — but freeing Ulyana means breaking the pact that keeps Thornfell's villages safe from the mountain's hunger. In the end, Coral chooses love over duty, shattering the pact and binding herself to Ulyana and the mountain alike, becoming the new keeper of the salt so that neither the court nor the villages need ever trade in souls again.
about_author: Vesper Blackwood is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent six years mapping mountain passes across Eastern Europe before turning to fiction. They write fantasy steeped in folk magic, smugglers' roads, and the quiet bargains people make to survive.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Moon
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Coral leads a smuggler's caravan through a hidden pass in the Thornfells, showing off her uncanny knowledge of the mountains while dodging questions about why she fled her apprenticeship. Emotional beat: restless competence masking loneliness; she belongs on the road but nowhere else.

chapters.title: A Book Bound in Brine
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Sheltering in an abandoned waystation, Coral finds a water-damaged prophecy book dated a century past — and reads tonight's date, her own description, and the words 'the Salt-Bearer descends.' The pages begin bleeding seawater. Emotional beat: dread and dark wonder as fate stops being abstract.

chapters.title: What the Mountain Took
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. A stranger intercepts the caravan: Wren, exiled scribe of the Undercourt, who confirms the prophecy is real and offers to guide them down. He reveals a soul was sold beneath the mountain generations ago. Emotional beat: wary alliance; two liars recognizing each other.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. The moon shows a thirteenth sliver no almanac predicts. Coral learns from a village crone that her grandmother sold a soul called Ulyana to the Undercourt to buy the valley's safety — and that Coral's blood is the only key. Emotional beat: inherited guilt; fury at a grandmother she never met.

chapters.title: The Tollgate of Teeth
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The pair enters the mountain through a gate of fossilized teeth that demands a memory as toll. Wren pays with his reason for exile; Coral glimpses what he lost. Emotional beat: first true vulnerability between them; trust purchased at a price.

chapters.title: Streets of Standing Water
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. They descend into the Undercourt, a drowned city where the dead trade in tides and the currency is longing. Coral poses as a soul-broker's daughter. Emotional beat: vertiginous beauty and alienation; she has never felt more like an outsider.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Souls
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Wren leads Coral into the Court archives to find Ulyana's entry in the Ledger of Souls, discovering the sale was witnessed by someone still living above. Emotional beat: the thrill of forbidden knowledge curdling as he realizes the witness will recognize him.

chapters.title: Court of the Drowned King
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Coral is summoned before the Drowned King, who knows exactly who she is and offers her Ulyana's freedom in exchange for taking up the salt-keeping herself. Emotional beat: seduction of duty; the bargain feels almost noble, which terrifies her.

chapters.title: Salt on Her Tongue
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV (first appearance). Imprisoned in a brine-crypt, Ulyana senses a descendant approaching and remembers the night she was sold — and the daughter she left behind. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into patience; hope she refuses to feel.

chapters.title: The Witness Above
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Climbing back to the surface, they find the sale's living witness: Mother Aldith, the hedge-witch Coral ran from. Aldith confesses she helped broker the deal and that Coral's flight was foretold too. Emotional beat: betrayal and reconciliation tangled together; Coral's anger meets Aldith's shame.

chapters.title: What Duty Costs
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Aldith reveals the full truth: if the pact breaks, the mountain wakes hungry, and every village in Thornfell pays. Coral must choose between freeing Ulyana and protecting thousands. Emotional beat: the weight of other people's survival pressing on a heart that just wants to do right by one person.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Night Market
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. On the thirteenth turn's eve, the Undercourt opens its night market. Wren schemes to steal the Ledger page bearing Ulyana's name, but the King's herald shadows them. Emotional beat: desperate ingenuity; Wren choosing Coral's cause over his own pardon.

chapters.title: A Page Torn True
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Coral tears Ulyana's page from the Ledger mid-theft, triggering the city's alarm-tides. They flee through flooding streets as the drowned dead rise to hunt them. Emotional beat: exhilarating terror; no going back now.

chapters.title: Drowned and Rising
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Freed by the torn page, Ulyana rises from the brine-crypt — but without her soul she is hollow, remembering nothing, knowing only that Coral smells like home. Emotional beat: aching recognition without memory; love outlasting identity.

chapters.title: The Hollow Woman
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Coral tries to reach Ulyana, who cannot remember her or her own sacrifice. Wren warns that a soulless salt-witch may become the very hunger the pact contained. Emotional beat: heartbreak of loving someone who doesn't know you; doubt creeping in.

chapters.title: The King's Mercy
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The Drowned King corners them, offering mercy: return the page, restore the pact, and Ulyana stays free but empty forever. Wren, tempted by his old life, must decide whose side he stands on. Emotional beat: loyalty tested against comfort; Wren refuses the pardon.

chapters.title: Where the Salt Was Made
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Following fragments of Ulyana's forgotten songs, Coral leads them to the First Saltworks deep in the mountain, where souls are rendered into the salt that feeds the pact. Emotional beat: pilgrimage-like determination; Coral betting everything on love as a map.

chapters.title: The Rendering
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. At the Saltworks, Ulyana confronts the vessel holding her soul and, in touching it, remembers everything — the sale, the daughter, the centuries. She also learns the truth: the mountain's hunger was created by the pact itself. Emotional beat: devastating clarity; the duty she died for was a lie.

chapters.title: Moonrise, Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. As the thirteenth moon completes, the King comes to claim them all. Coral shatters the pact-salt rather than surrender Ulyana, waking the mountain — and offering herself as its new keeper, bound not by contract but by choice. Emotional beat: climax; love declared not despite duty but as its replacement.

chapters.title: The Hunger Answered
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The mountain rages; Wren uses his scribe's craft to rewrite the terms in the old tongue, giving the mountain what it truly wanted — to be remembered, worshipped, mourned — not fed. Emotional beat: redemption through craft; the scholar finally writes something true.

chapters.title: Two Names in the Ledger
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Whole again, Ulyana finds her own entry crossed out and Coral's written beside it — two names, one bond, sanctioned by the rewritten mountain. She and Coral speak honestly for the first time. Emotional beat: tender reckoning; love chosen with full memory and open eyes.

chapters.title: The Keeper of the Salt
chapters.summary: Coral's POV. Spring returns to Thornfell. Coral, Ulyana, and Wren walk the smuggler's roads as keepers and witnesses, mending what the pact broke village by village. Emotional beat: resolution and belonging; Coral finally has somewhere — and someone — to come home to.
